answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can route trust across a decentralized trellis of peer endorsements. Capacity-bounded flows from verified seed nodes restrict credibility, forcing adversaries to expend scarce reputation capital to bridge graph bottlenecks. This design withstands an adversarial gale of synthetic nodes, cleaving unendorsed clusters like brittle shale. However, it penalizes honest newcomers lacking network ties and remains vulnerable to slow collusive infiltration.
